title: Add deterministic local doctor and bootstrap lifecycle
objective: Begin Repository Step 18 with deterministic, cross-platform `doctor` and `bootstrap` commands. Derive tool requirements from committed repository configuration, fail closed with actionable remediation, create isolated locked dependency state without shell-specific command strings, and bind the new lifecycle surface to permanent governance and conformance tests while leaving runtime orchestration, demo seeding and smoke acceptance for later bounded Step 18 packets.
deliverables: add repo.py doctor with deterministic human and JSON output, bootstrap/full profiles and actionable fail-closed remediation
derive Rust, Node and pnpm expectations from rust-toolchain.toml and package.json rather than duplicating version constants
add repo.py bootstrap with .venv, committed Python constraints, locked Cargo dependencies, frozen pnpm installation and generated-navigation verification
provide a side-effect-free bootstrap --dry-run plan built from argument arrays rather than shell command strings
classify local lifecycle tooling as operations-owned affected scope requiring Governance CI
run focused lifecycle tests through permanent native conformance and Governance CI
document only doctor and bootstrap as implemented while keeping the remaining Step 18 commands explicitly open
acceptance: the branch is based exactly on main commit 2659aed59a9fb9ac5a21d957f3eda85b54599d84 and contains only the declared Step 18 doctor/bootstrap packet files
`doctor --profile bootstrap` validates repository, Python, Git, exact pinned Rust, Cargo, supported Node and exact pinned pnpm without requiring Docker
`doctor --profile full` additionally validates Docker CLI, Compose v2 and a reachable Docker daemon
doctor checks have deterministic order, machine-readable schema, human rendering and actionable remediation for every blocking failure
bootstrap refuses failed prerequisites, creates an isolated `.venv`, uses committed constraints and lockfiles, and verifies locked Cargo metadata plus generated navigation
bootstrap dry-run executes no command and reports the exact ordered shell-free argument plan
future changes to `scripts/local_lifecycle.py` select Governance CI through affected-scope policy and workflow path filters
permanent conformance executes focused lifecycle tests without adding a duplicate permanent workflow
documentation does not claim `dev-up`, `dev-reset`, `seed-demo` or `smoke` are implemented and does not claim Step 18 or architecture 10/10 complete
one unchanged meaningful head passes every applicable permanent workflow and final changed-file, comment, review and thread inspection
non_goals: implement `dev-up`, `dev-reset`, `seed-demo` or `smoke` in this first Step 18 slice
start the Step 19 Customer Privacy worker lifecycle
change dependencies, lockfiles, runtime code, contracts, schemas, migrations, manifests or business behavior
silently install or globally switch system toolchains
complete Repository Step 18, Phase 8A, any expert module or architecture 10/10
